Faded police posters and old wanted flyers are peeling off the walls, barely visible under layers of dust. Faded notices cling to the walls above a trail of papers and broken furniture.

Faded blue and white stripes run along the building's exterior, now barely visible beneath layers of dirt. A lone crow perches on the broken sign, its black feathers stark against the weathered building.

blocks.inside_description: Desks are overturned, papers scattered across the floor, and the walls are peeling with age and neglect. The cafeteria is empty, with overturned tables and half-eaten meals left to rot in the corners of the room. The faint remnants of old graffiti and student artwork line the hallways, now faded and almost unrecognizable.
blocks.name: Springfield High School
blocks.outside_description: The flagpole stands empty, its base surrounded by weeds and cracked pavement. The school's brick walls are cracked and faded, with remnants of old murals peeling off in places. The school stands half-collapsed, its roof caving in at various points, but still somehow holding on.

blocks.outside_description: The tower rises above the neighbouring roofs, its upper windows pale with dust. Chunks of fallen masonry lie beside the entrance beneath a cracked company sign. Higher up, torn blinds flutter behind broken glass against the empty skyline.
